title: Finite geometric detection of scalar annihilation
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, X a Noetherian scheme, and F a constructible sheaf of Λ-modules on the small étale site of X. Then there are n and points x_i of X such that the intersection of the annihilators of the geometric stalks of F at the algebraic-closure points of x_i is contained in the intersection, over all étale objects U of X, of the annihilators of F(U).

proof.text: Choose the finite stratification from IsConstructibleSheaf.exists_stratification. Each stratum is Noetherian as an embedded subspace of X, hence compact. Its locally constant restriction has a trivializing etale cover. Etale chart maps are open, and isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover chooses finitely many chart images covering the stratum. Collect the annihilator ideals of their constant module values.

For a geometric point on a stratum, exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed lifts it through a selected chart containing its image. The over-site equivalence and uniqueness of left adjoints identify the localized constant chart with its upperStar restriction. Point.sheafFiberConstantSheafIso and Etale.upperStarCompSheafFiberIso give a module isomorphism from the original stalk to the constant value, hence equal annihilator ideals by LinearEquiv.annihilator_eq. Every algebraic-closure point of X lifts to its stratum by exists_comp_eq_of_mem_range; the same upperStar stalk comparison and uliftSheafFiberIso show that all displayed stalk ideals lie in the finite union of the stratum sets. Enumerate the finite range of the stalk-ideal function using Set.Finite.fin_param, and select one point realizing each enumerated ideal. Every stalk ideal is one of these representatives, so iInf_le gives containment of the representative intersection in the intersection of all stalk ideals.

For a scalar in the intersection of all stalk annihilators, transport annihilation along Point.uliftSheafFiberIso. Naturality of toPresheafFiber and presheafFiber_hom_ext prove that the stalk of the scalar endomorphism r • id_F is r • id on the stalk. Its stalk maps are zero, and sheafHom_ext_of_sheafFiber_map_algClosurePoint implies r • id_F = 0. Evaluating at each etale object and each section proves membership in its module annihilator, giving the required ideal containment. For empty X the finite range is empty and the enumeration has n=0; joint faithfulness applies vacuously. The zero sheaf has unit annihilators. These cases require no separate assumptions.

proof_origin.place: Finite-cover argument in finite-coefficient reduction, steps 1 and 3; compiled via finite range of stalk annihilator ideals, representative selection, and scalar-endomorphism conservativity.
